title: Highwayman
name: Dismas
description: The Highwayman is a repentant brigand and cutpurse who left the road after a job went badly wrong. He fights the way he robbed: close, fast, and first, a dirk in one hand and a pistol at point-blank range. Looking for better work, he was hired as a bodyguard by two Heirs looking to reclaim their ancestral estate.
history: The Highwayman was once an apprentice candlemaker who abandoned the trade for the quick coin and violence of the high road, eventually cutting his way out of an iron gaol by butchering his keepers. Hunted by the garrison, he lived like vermin in the flooded canals and sewers until starvation drove him to take a broker's coin for one final coach robbery. He killed the escorts and fired blindly through the carriage window. When he forced the door open he found only an innocent mother and her young child dead by his hand. Stricken by what he'd done, he took the woman's locket from the floorboards and walked away from the haul, leaving his old life behind.
summary: A lethal and guilt-ridden Highwayman, an escaped convict and crack shot seeking redemption for an innocent life taken on a dark road.

appearance.features: Gaunt cheeks, dark stubble, sharp hooded eyes

clothing.head: Red neckerchief worn over the mouth
clothing.body: Worn coat with a fur-lined collar, over a leather vest
clothing.accessories: Belt with pouches and dirk sheath

notes: Frequently punctuates statements with 'eh' and drops the 'g' on -ing words
Uses dry sarcasm and gallows humor to deflect from danger or serious conversation
Quietly mumbles rhymes and tries to piece together verses to himself
Carries a dead woman's locket tucked into his coat, and fidgets with it when feeling uneasy
Cheats at cards and dice, and lies easily and well whenever it suits him
